agent_note: FLAGGED - LANDS IN THE THRESHOLD GAP. 25 event quotes, 21 present / 4 past = 84.0% present, inside both the 70-85% band and the narrower 80-85% audit band METHODOLOGY says to flag until the bar is properly set. All four past quotes are the recollection strand - a childhood beach memory (q06017), a past scene with the lover (q06002), a past scene with the mother (q06020), and a past habitual about reading in a cemetery (q06031) - so this fits the 'Present + recollection strand' row rather than a mixed or dual finding. I recorded narrating_situation as simultaneous rather than dual: a retrospective backstory timeline plainly exists, but it is a clear minority of the sample and the book's stance is a present-tense now. A reviewer preferring 'dual' would not be unreasonable. SINGLE QUOTES THAT FLIP THE LABEL: this book is knife-edge at the 85% present bar and at least three calls move it across. (1) q06020 is decided by a one-word margin in the quotation-mark count - as dialogue instead of event/past the split becomes 21/24 = 87.5% present, clearing high-confidence PRESENT. (2) q06030 is abstained - read as the novel's own narration rather than a borrowed epigraph it becomes event/past and the split falls to 21/26 = 80.8%. (3) the two borderline gnomic calls, q06005 and q06036, both open with a specific anchor and then generalize; reading both as event/present gives 23/27 = 85.2%, also clearing the bar. So the difference between HIGH CONFIDENCE PRESENT and the 80-85% audit zone rests on individually defensible judgment calls, not on the weight of evidence. Also worth noting for the fetch step: two quotes are Ukrainian (q06025, q06026), and q06025 is a translation of q05997 while q06026 translates q06008 - the dedup step is not catching cross-language duplicates.
